main_topics.reason: The user opened with widening part and thinning hair and the whole conversation revolves around its cause and course.
User asked whether the thinning is from PCOS or something else and whether it will keep worsening.
User asked what can be done and whether it is permanent, over several turns.
User asked specifically whether spironolactone is safe and said they were nervous about hormone medicines.
Bot explained thyroid, iron and vitamin tests and the user engaged and planned to request them.
User asked what to bring and say so they are taken seriously.
User asked whether to see a regular doctor or a dermatologist and then planned to book.
User said the widening part freaks them out every time they look in the mirror and feared nothing could be done.
User asked in one turn about foods that help PCOS hair loss.
User mentioned a stressful exam period and asked if it could be part of the shedding, one short exchange.
User asked once what to avoid while waiting, such as straightening.

output.summary: A user with PCOS asked whether gradual hair thinning was due to PCOS or something else. The bot explained likely androgen-related loss, other causes to test for, stress-related shedding, treatment options including spironolactone safety, who to see and how to prepare. The user said it helped a lot, felt reassured and planned to book an appointment that week.
